title: 第88章 皇帝救不了，我能救！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 唐逸很愤怒。见过无耻的，但像唐敬这么无耻，却还一副我是为你考虑的样子，还真不多见。用大舅子的命，来谋算丈母娘的传家宝……这种人哪怕是亲爹，唐逸都忍不住想要亲手刀他了。而柳老夫人和沈氏看着此时的唐逸，眼睛都快瞪了。这气势，这架势，这孩子还是他们记忆中的乖孩子？要知道以前唐逸在唐敬面前，可是连头都不敢抬，现在却直接敢和唐敬对着干……不，是和满朝文武对着干。他……怎么敢的？唐敬见到诡计被戳穿，却没有太大的情绪波动，只是看向唐逸的目光，多了几分的恼怒和嘲弄。话说得铿锵有力，可你有这个本事吗？除了说大话，你还能做什么？“说得很好，但是……”唐敬自顾给自己倒了一杯茶，看向错愕的柳老太太道：“娘，这可是你儿子和孙子的性命，你相信他？”“你，敢把柳公瑾和柳文彦的面，交到他手上？”柳老太太听到这话，眉头也是轻微地皱了起来，不是不相信唐逸，而是唐逸的话太匪夷所思，天方夜谭了。他只是锦衣卫的一个百户，而柳公瑾的案子，涉及整个朝堂，一个锦衣卫百户，能单挑满朝文武数百人？想想都不可能啊！沈氏脸色已经苍白下来，双手紧攥成拳。姜氏本来就不想用《书圣帖》去救柳公瑾和柳文彦，柳公瑾和柳文彦的命，哪有《书圣帖》值钱。而且，昨日他回家，大哥姜正已经说了，让她想尽一切办法，将柳家的《书圣帖》弄到手。《书圣帖》进献给丞相，姜家必定一飞冲天，前程似锦，成为京都新贵。这事关姜家的未来，岂能用来救两个白痴废物！“娘，我相信小逸，小逸是个小孩子，不会骗人的。”姜氏当即站了出来，劝说柳老夫人。“对啊，柳老夫人，小逸不会骗人的，一点都不会，你们要相信他。”颜霜玉站在唐敬身侧，盯着柳老夫人阴阳怪气。一个十几岁的少年，想要挑战满朝文武？呵呵，简直就是痴人说梦。画儿都做不到，这废物想什么呢？柳老夫人看了一眼姜氏，目光有些冷，随即走上前，双手握住唐逸的手，眼睛盯着眼前少年俊逸的脸庞，认真道：“小逸，外婆只问你一次，你真能救你表哥和大舅？”唐逸郑重道：“我能！”“不对，外婆你等下，大舅我百分之百能救，表哥又怎么回事？”唐逸有些震惊，表哥前几日不是还好好的吗？怎么现在就需要他救了？结果听到这话，柳老夫人和沈氏比他还震惊，你表哥怎么回事你不知道？沈氏走上前道：“小逸，唐侍郎不是说你得罪了太子……不，得罪了幻音坊背后的势力，害得文彦和梁绍一群人，跟着你一起被抓进锦衣卫了吗？”“唐侍郎还说，他救你出来的时候，你都没告诉他你表哥被抓的事。”唐逸闻言脸顿时就黑了，唐敬救我？想什么呢？我要真被关进锦衣卫，唐敬这老小子估计做梦都能笑醒好吧！“唐侍郎，你还真是一次次刷新了我对无耻的认知啊！”唐逸扭头盯着唐敬，咬着牙一字一句道：“你救的我？我怎么不知道？”唐敬靠在椅子上，看着唐逸没说话。我做事，还需向你解释？“外婆，别听唐侍郎胡说八道，没有的事。”唐逸也懒得理会唐敬，安抚外婆道：“我进锦衣卫，是因为我和公主殿下有些误会，但误会已经解开了。”“至于柳文彦和梁绍他们被抓进监狱，是因为他们可能知道了小诗仙的身份。”“而陛下，暂时不想让人知道小诗仙的身份，放心吧，沈园诗会之后，柳文彦便会被释放的。”唐逸想了想就知道怎么回事了，肯定是他被三大美女花魁带走后，梁绍那家伙忍不住显摆，然后被锦衣卫一锅端了。他的身份，显然皇帝要拿在沈园诗会做文章，能让梁绍一群人坏了事？柳老夫人和沈氏相视一眼，都愣住了，竟然是这么回事？两人看向唐敬的目光顿时都冷了下来，从一开始唐敬的嘴里就没有一句实话。他只是在编制一个谎言，让柳家心甘情愿将《书圣帖》交给他。无耻之尤！“唐大人不愧是百官典范，今日老身算是领教了。”柳老夫人愤怒得攥紧拐杖，忍不住想要往敬的脑袋砸过去。儿子和孙子的命，在唐敬眼中竟然一文不值，随意利用。“呵！”面对柳老夫人的嘲讽，唐敬却只是嘲讽一笑。他自顾倒了一杯茶，轻轻转着茶杯，淡漠看向唐逸：“你知道柳公瑾的处境吗？他是公选出来的替罪羊，谁都救不了！”“包括陛下，陛下也救不了他。”“就算陛下念你外公的功劳，有心想要保柳公瑾，群臣也不会同意。”“因为这是陛下惹出来的祸，如果陛下不打仗，不逼着群臣还国库的钱，那户部左侍郎顾城也不会死，大家都相安无事。”“但现在陛下既然把这层窗户纸捅破了，那他就得给群臣一个交代。”“而柳公瑾，就是交代……你救？你告诉我，你怎么救？”唐逸看着唐敬坐在主位上，轻描淡写地确定了柳公瑾的命运，只觉得格外的嘲讽和可笑。靠，得意什么？真以为你们的所作所为可以天衣无缝？笑话。你们在我面前，早就已经明牌了好吗！顾城早就将你们的罪证，记录得清清楚楚明明白白了。“皇帝救不了，但我能救！”“而且，唐侍郎，你说错了！”唐逸手中的绣春刀撑在桌上，冷眸瞅着唐敬：“不是陛下给你们一个交代，是你们要给陛下，给大炎一个交代！”“你们真以为顾城死了，你们所做的事情就没人知道了？”“不好意思，我知道，顾城已经将一切告诉我了！”唐逸身体微微前倾，居高临下盯着唐敬：“譬如，你唐侍郎总共从国库，贪走了六万三千四百两，白银！”嗖！唐敬听到这话，猛地站了起来，死死盯向唐逸。
content_en: Tang Yi was very angry.I have seen shameless people, but it is rare to see someone as shameless as Tang Jing, who still acts like he is thinking about you.Using his brother-in-law's life to plot against his mother-in-law's family heirloom... Even if this kind of person is his own father, Tang Yi can't help but want to kill him with his own hands.When Mrs. Liu and Mrs. Shen looked at Tang Yi at this time, their eyes almost widened.With this momentum and posture, is this child still the good boy they remember?You must know that before Tang Yi was in front of Tang Jing, but he didn't even dare to raise his head, but now he directly dared to confront Tang Jing... no, he was confronting the civil and military officials of the Manchu Dynasty.How dare he...?When Tang Jing saw that the trick was exposed, he didn't have much emotion. He just looked at Tang Yi with a little more anger and ridicule.The words are sonorous and powerful, but do you have the ability?Besides talking big, what else can you do?"That's very well said, but..." Tang Jing poured himself a cup of tea, looked at the astonished Old Mrs. Liu and said, "Mom, this is the life of your son and grandson, do you believe him?" "You dare to hand Liu Gongjin and Liu Wenyan's face into his hands?" Old Mrs. Liu frowned slightly when she heard this. It wasn't that she didn't believe Tang Yi, but that Tang Yi's words were too unbelievable and impossible to believe.He is just a member of the Jinyiwei family, but Liu Gongjin's case involves the entire court. Can a Jinyiwei family member single-handedly challenge hundreds of civil and military personnel in the court?It’s impossible even if you think about it!Shen's face turned pale and she clenched her hands into fists.Mrs. Jiang originally did not want to use the "Shu Sheng Tie" to save Liu Gongjin and Liu Wenyan. The lives of Liu Gongjin and Liu Wenyan were not as valuable as the "Shu Sheng Tie".Moreover, when he came home yesterday, his eldest brother Jiang Zheng had already told her to do everything possible to get the Liu family's "Book of Saints".If the "Shu Sheng Tie" is presented to the prime minister, the Jiang family will surely soar into the sky, have a bright future, and become a new rich man in Kyoto.This is related to the future of the Jiang family. How can it be used to save two idiots and trash!"Mom, I trust Xiaoyi. Xiaoyi is a child and won't lie." Mrs. Jiang immediately stood up and persuaded Mrs. Liu."Yes, Mrs. Liu, Xiaoyi will not lie to others, not at all. You have to believe him." Yan Shuangyu stood beside Tang Jing, staring at Mrs. Liu with a strange expression.A teenage boy wants to challenge the civil and military forces of the Manchu Dynasty?Haha, it's just nonsense.If he can't even draw, what is this loser thinking?Mrs. Liu glanced at Mrs. Jiang, her eyes were a little cold, then she stepped forward, held Tang Yi's hand with both hands, stared at the handsome face of the young man in front of her, and said seriously: "Xiao Yi, grandma only asked you once, can you really save your cousin and uncle?" Tang Yi solemnly said: "I can!" "No, grandma, wait a minute, I can save my uncle 100%, what happened to my cousin?" Tang Yi was a little shocked, wasn't my cousin fine a few days ago?Why do you need his rescue now?After hearing this, Mrs. Liu and Mrs. Shen were even more shocked than him. You don't know what's going on with your cousin?Shen stepped forward and said, "Xiao Yi, did Tang Shilang say that you offended the prince... no, offended the forces behind Huanyinfang, causing Wen Yan, Liang Shao and others to be arrested into the Jinyi Guards with you?" "Tang Shilang also said that when he rescued you, you didn't tell him about your cousin's arrest." Tang Yi's face turned dark immediately after hearing this, Tang Jing, save me?What are you thinking about?If I were really imprisoned in Jinyiwei, this old boy Tang Jing would probably be able to laugh out of his dreams!"Tang Shilang, you have really refreshed my understanding of shamelessness time and time again!" Tang Yi turned to stare at Tang Jing, gritted his teeth and said word by word: "You saved me? Why didn't I know?" Tang Jing leaned on the chair and looked at Tang Yi without saying anything.I still need to explain to you what I do?"Grandma, don't listen to Tang Shilang's nonsense. It's nothing." Tang Yi was too lazy to pay attention to Tang Jing and comforted grandma: "I joined the Jinyi Guard because there was some misunderstanding between me and Her Highness the Princess, but the misunderstanding has been resolved." "As for Liu Wenyan and Liang Shao, they were taken to prison because they may have known about Xiao Shixian."Your Majesty, you don't want people to know Xiao Shixian's identity for the time being. Don't worry, Liu Wenyan will be released after the Shen Yuan Poetry Meeting."Tang Yi thought about it and knew what was going on. It must be that after he was taken away by the three beauties, Liang Shao couldn't help but show off, and then he was taken over by Jin Yiwei.His identity, obviously the emperor wanted to make a fuss about it at the Shen Yuan Poetry Society, could it cause Liang Shao and his group to cause trouble?Mrs. Liu and Mrs. Shen looked at each other and were stunned. Is this the case?The two people's eyes immediately turned cold when they looked at Tang Jing. From the beginning, there was no truth in Tang Jing's mouth.He was just making up a lie to make the Liu family willingly hand over the "Shu Sheng Tie" to him.How shameless!"Master Tang is indeed a model for all officials. Today I have learned from him." Madam Liu was so angry that she clenched her cane tightly and couldn't help but want to hit Jing on the head.The lives of his son and grandson were worthless in Tang Jing's eyes and could be used at will."Ha!" Faced with Madam Liu's ridicule, Tang Jing just smiled mockingly.He poured a cup of tea by himself, gently twirled the cup, and looked at Tang Yi indifferently: "Do you know Liu Gongjin's situation? He is the scapegoat elected by the public. No one can save him!" "Including Your Majesty, Your Majesty can't save him." "Even if Your Majesty appreciates your grandfather's merits and wants to protect Liu Gongjin, the ministers will not agree." "Because this is the disaster caused by Your Majesty. If Your Majesty does not fight, you will not force the people to save him."If the minister repays the money to the treasury, Gu Cheng, the left servant of the household department, will not die, and everyone will be safe." "But now that your majesty has broken the window, he has to give an explanation to the ministers." "As for Liu Gongjin, you are going to save me?Tell me, how can you save him?" Tang Yi felt particularly mocking and ridiculous as he watched Tang Jing sitting on the main seat and casually confirming Liu Gongjin's fate.Damn, what are you so proud of?Do you really think what you do is perfect?joke.You have already made your cards clear in front of me, okay?Gu Cheng has already recorded the evidence of your crimes clearly and clearly."The emperor can't save you, but I can save you!" "Besides, Minister Tang, you are wrong!" Tang Yi propped the embroidered spring knife on the table and looked at Tang Jing coldly: "His Majesty is not giving you an explanation, but you have to give an explanation to His Majesty and Dayan!" "Do you really think that Gu Cheng is dead and no one knows what you have done?" "I'm sorry, I know that Gu Cheng has told me everything!" Tang Yi leaned forward slightly.
title_en: Chapter 88 The emperor can’t save him, but I can!
